moonphys

A deterministic 2D rigid body engine written in MoonBit: SAT collision detection, impulse solver with warm starting, Coulomb friction, revolute and distance joints, sleeping, and a sort-and-sweep broadphase. Every frame below was produced by moon run cmd/main --target js.

Pyramid stack · friction ramp · bouncing balls

Five link chain · double pendulum

Plank bridge · distance joints
